body.title: ci: disable PR auto commenter on pull requests
body.body: ## Summary - disable PR Auto Commenter for pull request events - keep workflow manual-only via workflow_dispatch ## Why - requested to remove auto commenter from all PRs <!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai --> ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Chores** * Updated GitHub Actions workflow configuration to require manual triggering instead of automatic execution on pull requests. <!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
